summary.zh-TW: 同一份財報，股東、債權人、員工與客戶各自在意的數字不一樣。本章全部是不計分的取捨思辨題：先選一個立場，再看三個方案各自的得失。解說是網站的觀點，沒有標準答案。
summary.en: The same set of financial statements means different things to shareholders, creditors, employees and customers. Every question in this chapter is an unscored judgement question: pick a position, then read the gains and costs of all three options. The commentary is the site’s own view; there is no single right answer.
